versions.changelog: Store listing metadata refresh: display name / topics / categories upgraded to the register-series standard; version aligned with platform numbering (1.0.1). Metadata only, no functional changes.

PowPow Simple EN 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Lets users publish travelogues and photos as posts to PowPow, or create digital humans pinned to the public map.
- Supports both English and Chinese user input; always responds in the user's language.
- Includes account registration/login, session management, place-name resolution, image upload, post publishing, and post deletion for cleanup.
- Provides direct links to product screenshots based on user questions to help visualize PowPow features.
- Triggered only when users explicitly express intent to publish to PowPow.
- User experience focused: serves users gently and guides each step without lecturing or technical jargon.
